query:
insert into signatures (map_id, solar_system_id, signature_id, "group", name)
               values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
               on conflict (map_id, solar_system_id, signature_id) do update
                   set "group" = excluded."group",
                       name = coalesce(excluded.name, signatures.name),
                       updated_at = now()
